personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean with 6 Glass / Luxe surfaces
personality_one_liner: A cinematic, premium travel companion where generous iOS-native layout framing, high-fidelity glassmorphism, and deep turquoise accents elevate Socotra's natural beauty into a high-end booking experience.

spacing.rule: Generous iOS-native margins (lg/xl) around cards. Use gap inside Flex. Do not cluster elements without breathing room. Ensure proper safe-area usage.

do's: Use glass headers on scrolling destination content.
Use frosted glass overlay over brand-tinted background for bottom tab bar.
Float a glass CTA button container at the bottom of the destination detail page.
dont's: Do not blur forms, input fields, or dense text cards.
Do not use glass if content underneath isn't adequately darkened or tinted for readability.

screens.name: Discover (Home)
screens.purpose: Serve as the primary visual hook and entry point for Socotra's offerings.

states.loading: Skeleton UI matching the card structure.

screens.layout: Full-bleed hero carousel at the top with a subtle 2-stop vertical gradient scrim for text contrast. Below hero: multiple horizontal scrolling rows (Featured, Popular, Experiences, Products) mapped to `surfaceSecondary` cards with `lg` radius and `md` gap. Include a 'sticky' glass navigation header that appears on scroll.

screens.name: Interactive Map
screens.purpose: Allow users to explore destinations geospatially with category filters.

states.empty: No markers found for the selected category.

screens.layout: Full-screen Google Map. Floating glass search bar at safe-area-top. A horizontal scrolling list of pill-shaped category filters below the search bar. Tapping a pin reveals a bottom-sheet (using `@gorhom/bottom-sheet`) with a destination summary card and a 'Get Directions' CTA.

screens.name: Destination Detail
screens.purpose: Provide an immersive, informative view of a specific location to drive favoriting or booking.
screens.layout: Cinematic full-bleed hero image with a glass header (containing back button and share/favorite). Text content sits below on `surface` with generous `xl` padding. Use modular cards for 'Activities' and 'Tags'. Important: Pin a sticky CTA ('Get Directions' or 'Book Trip') anchored at the bottom inside a glass container over scrolling content.

screens.name: Local Marketplace
screens.purpose: Discover and purchase local handicrafts and services.

states.empty: Illustration of a traditional basket with 'No products found' text.

screens.layout: 2-column grid utilizing `flexWrap: 'wrap'` and `justifyContent: 'space-between'`. Each product card has an aspect ratio 1:1 image, followed by name, price in `brandPrimary`, and a seller row. A sticky category filter row (scrollable horizontally) remains pinned under the header.

screens.name: Trips List & Detail
screens.purpose: Browse tourism packages and view comprehensive itinerary details.
screens.layout: List: Vertical stack of full-width cards (`surfaceSecondary`) with large cover photos and highlight metadata (duration, seats). Detail: Similar to Destination Detail but includes structured itinerary steps (timeline UI) and a persistent 'Book Now' sticky bottom CTA.

screens.name: Account & Auth
screens.purpose: Manage user profile, bookings, and authenticate via Email/Google.

states.empty: Not logged in state showing a cinematic background with auth options.
states.error: Form validation errors displayed below inputs in `error` color.

screens.layout: Auth: Cinematic full-screen landscape background with a dark gradient scrim. Clean, single-column input form positioned in the lower third. Account: Clean iOS settings-style list with chevron icons, user avatar at the top.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow Arabic RTL guidelines. Use React Native's `I18nManager.isRTL` to conditionally flip layouts if not natively handled by flex row. Ensure padding/margins use logical properties (e.g., `paddingStart`, `paddingEnd`).
Mirror ONLY directional icons (like back arrows or chevrons). Do not mirror universal icons like play buttons, logos, or clocks.
Implement the 'iOS-Native Clean + Glass/Luxe' fusion: Generous padding around all content blocks, use glass headers over scrolling content, and sticky bottom CTAs using blurred backgrounds.

For all images that have text overlaid on them (like the Discover Hero carousel or Destination details), MANDATORY implement a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to dark surfaceInverse at bottom) behind the text to guarantee contrast.
Do NOT use indigo, violet, or pure navy blue anywhere. Adhere to the provided Socotra-inspired teal/turquoise palette.
Typography: Use 'Cairo' for large headers/display elements and 'Tajawal' for body text. Both handle Arabic and English cleanly.

Destination Detail & Trips Detail MUST feature a sticky 'Book' or 'Get Directions' CTA wrapped in a Glass container pinned to the bottom above the home indicator, allowing content to scroll beneath it.
